implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience

• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para GTM Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Our Client

Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain.

Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in.


The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and

product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue

team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount.

If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought \"this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\" this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build.


What You'll Own

Outbound & Account Intelligence

  • Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers
  • Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic \"growing your trucking business\" pitch
  • Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack

Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence

  • Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand
  • Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems)

Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics

  • Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing
  • Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings

Field & Event Activation

  • Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline
  • Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works

Internal AI Tooling

  • Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms
  • Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering



What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company
  • Working proficiency in Python and SQL; comfortable in JavaScript when needed
  • Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn
  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management
  • A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time

Strongly Preferred

  • Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast
  • Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical
  • Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration

You'll thrive here if you

  • Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority
  • Default to building rather than briefing; You'd rather ship a v1 in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc
  • Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers; their adoption of what you build is the measure of whether it worked-
  • Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes

What Success Looks Like

  • By 90 days: Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team; outbound personalization quality is measurably higher
  • By 6 months: Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling
  • By 12 months: PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:

Senior Front End Engineer



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience

• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para GTM Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Our Client

Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain.

Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in.


The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and

product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue

team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount.

If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought \"this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\" this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build.


What You'll Own

Outbound & Account Intelligence

  • Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers
  • Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic \"growing your trucking business\" pitch
  • Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack

Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence

  • Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand
  • Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems)

Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics

  • Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing
  • Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings

Field & Event Activation

  • Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline
  • Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works

Internal AI Tooling

  • Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms
  • Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering



What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company
  • Working proficiency in Python and SQL; comfortable in JavaScript when needed
  • Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot,
  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management
  • A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time

Strongly Preferred

  • Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast
  • Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical
  • Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration

You'll thrive here if you

  • Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority
  • Default to building rather than briefing; You'd rather ship a v1 in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc
  • Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers; their adoption of what you build is the measure of whether it worked-
  • Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes

What Success Looks Like

  • By 90 days: Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team; outbound personalization quality is measurably higher
  • By 6 months: Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling
  • By 12 months: PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

Preferred Experience

  • Experience implementing SaaS, enterprise software, operational systems, infrastructure systems, telecom systems, engineering systems, or project control platforms.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:

Chief Operating Officer


Our client’s company is a US-based high-end luxury design business specializing in curated furniture, lighting, and interior design-related products. The company works with discerning clients and design professionals, offering carefully selected pieces and a refined customer experience.


We are looking for a highly capable Chief Operating Officer / Head of Operations to serve as the founder’s #2 and right hand in running the business.

This is a critical leadership role for someone who can manage teams, create structure, set and track KPIs, improve reporting systems, and help turn the founder’s ideas into clear, organized execution. The ideal candidate is highly intelligent, strategic, analytical, and people-oriented, with excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong trust with the founder and the team.


Key Responsibilities


  • Oversee and manage multiple teams across the business.
  • Build, improve, and implement organizational structure, workflows, and reporting systems.
  • Set, measure, and track KPIs, metrics, and team performance.
  • Ensure all teams are reporting progress clearly and consistently.
  • Translate the founder’s ideas, priorities, and business goals into organized action plans.

  • Keep teams aligned, accountable, motivated, and supported.
  • Identify operational gaps, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Act as a trusted strategic partner to the founder in leading the company forward.


Ideal Candidate


  • Strong experience in operations, business management, or executive leadership.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Highly organized, strategic, and analytical.
  • Comfortable working directly with a founder, CEO, or business owner.
  • Able to quickly understand ideas and turn them into structured execution.
  • Strong understanding of KPIs, performance tracking, reporting, and business metrics.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Able to motivate teams while maintaining accountability.
  • Proactive, decisive, trustworthy, and emotionally intelligent.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, founder-led company.


Preferred Background


  • Experience as a COO, Head of Operations, Operations Manager, General Manager, Chief of Staff, or similar leadership role.
  • Experience in luxury goods, interior design, furniture, retail, showroom operations, e-commerce, or a creative/service-based business is a plus.
  • Experience building systems, processes, dashboards, SOPs, and reporting structures.


About the Role


This is not just an operational role. Our client is looking for a true leadership partner who can bring structure, accountability, and strategic execution to the business while building a strong, high-trust relationship with the founder.

The right person will be able to think strategically, act decisively, communicate clearly, and connect with people authentically.

title: Promo Team Lead - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo Team Lead - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Promo Team Lead to lead the end-to-end creation of promotional ads, trailers, and performance creatives for Pocket FM audio series in the Brazilian market.


As a Promo Team Lead, you will manage a team of promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and dubbing partners to create high-quality promotional ads for Pocket FM audio series.


The role requires strong understanding of promo creation, ad storytelling, localization, dubbing workflows, quality control, team management, and creative optimization. You will oversee fresh promo creation, adaptation of ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese, production quality, timely delivery, and reworks for ads that are not meeting performance benchmarks.


Key Responsibilities


1. Team Leadership & Creative Direction

  • Lead and guide promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and external dubbing partners.
  • Provide creative direction across writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video editing, and final delivery.
  • Ensure the team is well-utilized, motivated, and aligned with business and creative goals.
  • Build a high-ownership culture focused on quality, speed, and performance.

2. Promo Creation & Localization

  • Oversee the creation of fresh promo ads, trailers, and long-form promotional scripts for audio series.
  • Adapt successful ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Ensure all promos are culturally relevant, emotionally engaging, and suitable for Brazilian audiences.
  • Guide the team on hooks, story setup, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and audience entry points.

3. Production & Quality Control

  • Own the end-to-end promo production process from brief to final asset delivery.
  • Quality check every stage, including writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video creation, and final output.
  • Review scripts, VO/dubbing output, audio edits, video cuts, captions, and final creatives.
  • Ensure every asset meets Pocket FM’s creative, language, production, and performance standards.

4. Dubbing Agency Management

  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard dubbing agencies for Brazilian Portuguese production.
  • Coordinate with agencies for script handover, voice casting, recording, revisions, and delivery.
  • Review dubbing output for pronunciation, emotion, pacing, tone, and character fit.
  • Track agency timelines, pending deliverables, feedback loops, and final submissions.

5. Performance Reworks & Optimization

  • Review ads that are not meeting benchmark metrics and identify key creative issues.
  • Create detailed and actionable rework hypotheses to improve ad performance.
  • Suggest improvements such as stronger hooks, sharper conflicts, better pacing, improved localization, or revised visuals.
  • Guide the team in creating alternate openings, new versions, and stronger creative angles.
  • Apply campaign learnings to improve future promo concepts and execution.

6. Process, Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain show-level trackers for all ads being written, adapted, dubbed, edited, reviewed, and delivered.
  • Track ownership, status, timelines, delays, feedback, and final delivery for each asset.
  • Share weekly progress reports with the India team and relevant stakeholders.
  • Create SOPs, checklists, and workflows to avoid leakages across the production process.

7. AI Tool Adoption

  • Use GenAI tools for ad writing, ideation, VO production, image creation, video creation, and workflow improvement.
  • Guide the team in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, and efficiency.
  • Continuously explore new AI tools and workflows for promo production.
  • Ensure AI-assisted outputs are reviewed for storytelling quality, cultural accuracy, and production readiness.

8. Market & Audience Understanding

  • Apply strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption habits, and market trends.
  • Ensure promos feel native, relevant, and compelling for Brazilian audiences.
  • Stay updated on digital ads, audio entertainment, trailer formats, and performance creative trends.


Qualifications


  • Degree in Filmmaking, Marketing, Advertising, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in ad creation, promo creation, trailer development, marketing creatives, ad copywriting, or performance creative production.
  • Strong understanding of marketing, ad storytelling, promo creation, and audience engagement.
  • Experience leading creative or production teams, including writers, editors, sound engineers, or external vendors.
  • Excellent command of English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption patterns, and cultural nuances.
  • Experience working with dubbing agencies, VO artists, production teams, or post-production vendors.
  • Skilled in GenAI tools for writing, VO production, image creation, video creation, and creative workflow improvement.
  • Ability to create SOPs, trackers, review systems, and scalable creative processes.
  • Strong analytical ability to review ad performance and convert insights into actionable creative reworks.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
  • Strategic thinker with strong ownership and business growth orientation.
  • Understanding of performance marketing on Meta and UAC is a plus.


Ideal Candidate


The ideal candidate is a creative leader who understands storytelling, promo production, and performance-driven advertising. They should be able to lead a multi-functional team, manage dubbing partners, maintain strong quality control, and deliver high-quality promo assets at scale.

They should have strong knowledge of Brazilian audiences, excellent creative judgment, hands-on production understanding, and the ability to turn performance feedback into clear creative action.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ 7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology.


This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.


About Ten16 Creative

Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.


We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.


About the Role

The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.


This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.


You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.


You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.


You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.


Qualifications

The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.


They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado] em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.


Imporante:

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Front End Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Front End Engineer



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience

• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Cientista de Dados SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cientista de Dados SR em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cientista de Dados - Machine Learning


Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados talentoso e inovador para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve ter sólida experiência em Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning, com habilidades em classificação, Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), técnicas estatísticas e validação de modelos. Esperamos que você tenha um forte entendimento de feature engineering e métricas de desempenho.


Responsabilidades:


- Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Modelos: Construir, treinar e validar modelos de machine learning, aplicando técnicas avançadas de classificação e NLP para resolver problemas complexos de negócios.

- Trabalho com Linguagens e Bibliotecas: Utilizar Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas e numpy, além de frameworks de NLP para desenvolver soluções eficientes e escaláveis.

- Integração de IA Generativa e LLMs: Trabalhar com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs) e IA Generativa, utilizando APIs e técnicas de prompt engineering para avaliação e integração de respostas em pipelines analíticos.

- Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura em Cloud: Atuar em ambientes de computação em nuvem, especialmente utilizando AWS, S3, SageMaker e Glue, para otimizar processos de dados e Machine Learning.

- Arquitetura de Soluções: Projetar e implementar soluções end-to-end, criando pipelines analíticos e integrando modelos em ambientes produtivos para maximizar a eficiência operacional.


Além das habilidades técnicas, o candidato deve possuir competências profissionais como comunicação técnica clara, autonomia para tomar decisões e a capacidade de atuar em contextos de negócios complexos.


Se você é apaixonado por dados e tecnologia, e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica que valoriza a inovação, se inscreva!

description:

You'll architect and lead AI product development, transforming logistics with intelligent automation.


Compensation:

USD 7k - 16k/month


Location:

Remote (for residents of Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, and the United States)


Mission of FreightPOP:

\"We simplify and streamline the transportation management experience for manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and 3PL’s by reducing friction and connecting systems for a seamless and optimal supply chain.\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have +8 year s experience in Software development.
  • You have +6 years experience in SDLC (Software development life cycle), Agile methodologies.
  • You are proficient in AI agents, AI product development, AWS, machine learning, Microsoft Azure, Python, React.js, software architecture, tech leadership, TypeScript
  • English - Fully fluent.

Compensation will vary based on Location. Central and South America in the range of $7k to $10k per month. In the US the range will be $12k to $16k per month. Skill and experinece based.



Essential Job Functions/Requirements:


AI Product Development & Technical Leadership:

  • Lead the technical execution of FreightPOP’s AI product initiatives and roadmap.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering leadership to define and deliver AI-powered capabilities across the platform.
  • Architect and guide development of AI solutions including copilots, agents, optimization engines, and intelligent automation.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with business priorities and deliver measurable value to customers.


Solution Architecture & Platform Integration:

  • Define technical architecture and development standards for AI-powered capabilities.
  • Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML tools, frameworks, vector databases, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Guide the integration of AI decisioning with FreightPOP’s core platform systems, including logistics workflows, databases, and operational services.


Hands-on Development & Technical Oversight:

  • Act as a hands-on contributor while leading technical direction for AI initiatives.
  • Prototype and validate AI concepts before scaling into production-ready solutions.
  • Review implementations to ensure alignment with architectural guidance and engineering best practices.
  • Provide technical mentorship and direction to engineers contributing to AI initiatives.


AI Innovation & Continuous Improvement:

  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and methodologies.
  • Champion experimentation and innovation within the engineering organization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve FreightPOP’s platform through AI-driven automation, optimization, and intelligent decision support.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Agile Execution:

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to deliver AI capabilities rapidly and effectively.
  • Support rapid iteration cycles typical of AI development.
  • Help guide development practices that balance experimentation speed with production reliability.


Job Qualifications:


Education:

  • STEM bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.


Experience:

  • 8+ years software development experience with SaaS technology.
  • 6+ years SDLC in an Agile / SCRUM environment.
  • 4+ years in a Senior or Lead engineering role.
  • Experience building or integrating AI-powered products or platforms.
  • Experience designing scalable distributed systems.
  • Logistics or supply chain experience a plus.


Technology Environment:

  • FreightPOP’s platform is built on a modern SaaS architecture leveraging technologies including:
  • Backend: C#, .NET APIs and services.
  • Frontend: React (TypeScript-based UI).
  • Database: Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • The AI Tech Lead will work within this environment while introducing and integrating modern AI technologies such as large language model APIs, AI agents, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks as part of FreightPOP’s evolving platform architecture.


Skills & Expertise:

  • Passion for leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI ecosystems (LLMs, MCPs, agents, embeddings, vector databases).
  • Experience building AI-powered software systems or integrating AI capabilities into applications.
  • Experience designing scalable SaaS architectures and distributed systems.
  • Ability to rapidly prototype and iterate AI solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making skills.
  • Experience in evaluating and adopting new technologies.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across product, engineering, and leadership teams, including in distributed team environments.


Other Abilities:

  • Strong curiosity and passion for AI innovation.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced and evolving technical environments.
  • Self-driven problem solver capable of working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies.


Your potential leader(s):

  • Kenin Page
  • Kurt Johnson

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Please note: All applications must be submitted in English. Resumes must be written in English and the entire interview process will be conducted in English. We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity to grow with the team.


Title : Technical Project Manager / Coordinator

Location : Remote

Employment Type : Independent Contractor I Full-Time

Reports To : Head of Project Management

Works Closely With : Software Dev Team, Product Team, Fellow Ops Project Managers

Monthly Compensation : $2,000 - $2,500


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager who owns delivery end-to-end — from kickoff through launch — across software, product, hardware, and operations work. You’ll sit at the intersection of creative ambition and technical execution, leading the build lifecycle of games, activations, physical technology, and internal tools while protecting timelines, budgets, scope, and quality.


This is a hands-on role for someone who can run multiple concurrent projects, build the systems that keep them on track, and act as the connective tissue across sales, operations, creative, software, fabrication, logistics, finance, vendors, field teams, and clients. You’ll own ClickUp as a central project system, stand up scalable processes and SOPs, and drive profitability through disciplined tracking of scope, change orders, billbacks, and logistics costs. If you like structure, care about quality, and want real ownership — this is your role!!


RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Coordination & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end delivery from kickoff through completion — ensuring projects ship on time, on budget, within scope, and to quality standards
  • Run multiple concurrent projects across operations, keeping all stakeholders aligned
  • Build and maintain project timelines, roadmaps, dashboards, and task lists; flag risks early and drive deliverables to completion
  • Participate in standups, planning sessions, and milestone reviews to keep momentum and accountability high


Systems, Process & ClickUp Ownership

  • Own and optimize ClickUp as the central project management system — workflows, templates, dashboards, task ownership, timelines, dependencies, and accountability
  • Build and implement scalable PM processes, SOPs, checklists, and reporting structures that improve efficiency and reduce confusion, rework, and delays
  • Advocate for and drive adoption of these systems across operations, production, and software teams so they become the single source of truth


Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Manage coordination between sales, operations, creative, software, fabrication, logistics, finance, vendors, field teams, and clients
  • Serve as the communication bridge across technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating requirements clearly in both directions
  • Push for clarity, updates, and decisions to keep projects moving with professionalism and urgency


Commercial Ownership & Margin Protection

  • Maximize client billbacks, change orders, recoverable expenses, and margin by tracking scope changes, additional requests, rush fees, logistics costs, and out-of-scope work
  • Track project budgets, actual costs, timelines, risks, vendor performance, and profitability — escalating issues early and recommending solutions
  • Identify and implement cost-reduction opportunities across logistics, procurement, vendors, installation partners, field services, and operational workflows


Logistics & Deployment

  • Improve logistics planning and execution — shipping, receiving, staging, storage, installation, pickup, returns, site readiness, and deployment tracking
  • Track vendors, purchase orders, deliveries, and project dependencies, ensuring nothing slips between teams


Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead continuous operational improvement — identifying inefficiencies, strengthening internal accountability, improving vendor performance, and creating repeatable systems
  • Own the design-to-development handoff so files and assets are complete and developer-ready before a build begins


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of project management experience, ideally in a digital agency, software, experiential, or tech-adjacent environment, with a track record owning delivery end-to-end
  • Proven ability to run multiple concurrent projects and drive them to completion independently
  • Deep, hands-on experience with ClickUp (or similar: Asana, Monday, Jira) — not just using it, but designing workflows, dashboards, and templates others rely on
  • Strong commercial instincts: experience tracking budgets, change orders, billbacks, recoverable costs, and protecting margin
  • Experience coordinating logistics, vendors, procurement, and/or field/installation work
  • Solid understanding of QA concepts and what good testing looks like in a fast-paced build cycle
  • Basic to intermediate design-file literacy (Figma, Photoshop, or similar) for reviewing handoff readiness
  • Clear, direct communicator who can translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders and push for accountability
  • Strong timeline and risk-management instincts — you don’t wait to be told something’s off track


NICE TO HAVE - not required!

Background in experiential marketing, activations, branded tech, or DOOH / digital signage

Exposure to hardware/fabrication, installation, or field-services coordination

title: Commercial Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Commercial Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Overview  


Upstart AEC is hiring a Commercial Manager  to lead revenue-focused operations across sales, client communication, and internal delivery coordination. 


This is a full-time, fully remote role with Upstart AEC . The ideal candidate is a senior, sales-minded commercial leader who can operate in a CRO-adjacent capacity, owning revenue execution while ensuring strong alignment across Talent Acquisition, Account Management, and Delivery. 


This person will be responsible for moving qualified opportunities through the sales cycle, keeping deals on track, improving conversion from meetings to revenue, and ensuring internal teams stay aligned around client expectations and business outcomes. 


The ideal candidate brings senior-level sales experience , preferably 10+ years , with experience working with the U.S. market or U.S.-based clients . Experience in nearshore services  is preferred, as is experience helping grow a company from approximately $4M–$5M to $15M–$20M USD  in revenue. 


Key Responsibilities  


  • Own the full sales cycle from qualified opportunity to close, ensuring deals progress consistently and do not stall. 
  • Maintain clear next steps for every active deal and ensure consistent follow-up with prospects and clients. 
  • Partner with outbound efforts to convert meetings into revenue and improve conversion rates. 
  • Drive consistent client communication and follow-up to maintain momentum and build long-term relationships. 
  • Own day-to-day commercial and operational coordination across Talent Acquisition, Account Management, and Delivery. 
  • Hold Talent Acquisition, Account Management, and Delivery teams accountable to timelines, quality standards, and client expectations. 
  • Maintain CRM accuracy, pipeline visibility, and updated deal information. 
  • Monitor active opportunities, identify risks, and drive corrective actions when deals or delivery timelines are at risk. 
  • Provide weekly reporting on pipeline, revenue, and operational performance. 
  • Highlight risks, blockers, and opportunities for improvement across sales and delivery operations. 
  • Help ensure the team remains focused on revenue generation, client satisfaction, and execution quality. 
  • Support revenue growth by improving sales execution, operational follow-through, and conversion from meetings to closed business. 


Required Skills  


  • 10+ years of senior sales or commercial leadership experience . 
  • Experience working with the U.S. market or U.S.-based clients . 
  • Strong sales and revenue mindset, with the ability to own opportunities from qualified lead to close. 
  • Experience managing sales pipelines, client follow-up, and deal progression. 
  • Strong CRM discipline, including accurate pipeline tracking and clear next-step management. 
  • Ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams and hold stakeholders accountable. 
  • Strong communication skills with both clients and internal team members. 
  • Ability to identify stalled deals, operational gaps, or risks and take action to move things forward. 
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities may shift. 
  • Comfortable reporting on pipeline, revenue, operational performance, and key risks. 
  • Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability. 
  • Ability to operate at both a strategic and hands-on level, balancing revenue leadership with day-to-day execution. 


Nice-to-Have Skills  


  • Experience in a revenue leadership, sales operations, commercial operations, or CRO-adjacent role. 
  • Experience in nearshore services. 
  • Experience helping grow a company from approximately $4M–$5M to $15M–$20M USD  in revenue. 
  • Experience working with Talent Acquisition, Account Management, or Delivery teams. 
  • Experience improving meeting-to-revenue conversion rates. 
  • Experience managing client relationships in a service-based business environment. 
  • Experience selling services, recruiting solutions, staffing, consulting, or other people-based business solutions. 


Compensation Range


  • Base compensation: $60,000–$100,000 USD
  • Commission: Yes
  • On-target earnings: $120,000–$200,000 USD

description:

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients, a supplyy chain focused company.


Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Content Author Specialist to support the creation, management, and optimization of digital content across our web platforms. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has a strong understanding of content management systems, and is passionate about delivering high-quality user experiences.

Graphic design experience is not required, but candidates with a design background will have an added advantage in enhancing visual content and collaborating effectively with creative teams.


Key Responsibilities

Author, edit, and publish web content using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)

Maintain and update website pages, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with brand standards

Collaborate with UX, marketing, and development teams to implement content strategies

Manage digital assets, including images, videos, and documents within the AEM Digital Asset Manager (DAM)

Ensure content is optimized for performance, accessibility, and SEO best practices

Troubleshoot content issues and provide solutions within AEM

Follow governance standards, workflows, and approval processes for content publishing

Assist with content audits and quality assurance to ensure a seamless user experience


Required Qualifications

Proven experience working with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) as a content author or in a similar role

Strong understanding of content management systems and web publishing workflows

Familiarity with HTML basics and web content structure (no coding required, but helpful)

High attention to detail and strong organizational skills

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.)

Experience with Figma

ADA Compliance experience a plus

Basic knowledge of graphic design principles (layout, typography, visual hierarchy)

Experience working closely with UX/UI design teams

Understanding of responsive design and mobile-first content strategies

Knowledge of analytics tools or A/B testing platforms

What Sets You Apart

A strong eye for visual detail and user experience

Ability to turn design concepts into polished, web-ready content

Proactive problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn new tools

Local : Vargem Pequena/Florianópolis

Salário : R$ 3.100,65 a R$ 3.418,47+ benefícios


Descrição:

A Levteck Tecnologia Viva busca por um(a) Técnico de Laboratório Industrial Júnior para compor nosso time e contribuir com a organização e fluidez dos nossos processos! 

Se você é uma pessoa que gosta de processos bem descritos, trabalho em equipe, atenta aos detalhes, responsável, com raciocínio lógico e boa comunicação, essa oportunidade é para você!


Principais atividades:

- É de responsabilidade do Técnico de Laboratório Júnior preparar e realizar o inóculo dos reatores, bem como a drenagem e limpeza deles;

- Efetuar a produção dos meios de cultura, esterilização e controles de qualidade dos meios;

- Preparar e executar análises físico-químicas e microbiológicas;

- Embalar e expedir os produtos conforme o padrão pré-estabelecido;

- Efetuar a calibração do phmetro semanalmente;

- Efetuar o controle de estoque de consumíveis, reagentes e produto finalizado;

- Efetuar os registros pertinentes a cada atividade de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos e de acordo com as Boas Práticas de Fabricação;

- Auxiliar na retirada dos lixos do laboratório e da copa diariamente e auxiliar na segregação correta do lixo reciclado;

- Realizar todas as atividades com a máxima qualidade, mantendo a organização. 


Perfil comportamental necessário:

Acuidade; Organização;​ Responsabilidade;​ Pró-atividade; Gostar de trabalhar em equipe;​ Persistência; Agilidade; ​Bom relacionamento interpessoal; Habilidade para lidar com tarefas de média complexidade; Cultura da Qualidade.​


Perfil técnico necessário:

Ter formação em engenharia de alimentos, ciência de alimentos, biologia, farmácia ou áreas correlatas. Ter conhecimento básico sobre microrganismos e formas de desinfecção, boas práticas laboratoriais.


Conhecimento diferencial:

Técnicas de microbiologia, plaqueamento, conhecimento de meios de cultura, contagem de leveduras, trabalhar em fluxo laminar, identificar contaminações.


Formação:

Nível superior em eng de alimentos, biologia, biotecnologia, bioprocessos, farmácia ou áreas correlatas.

title: CONSULTORA COMERCIAL | CLÍNICA DE HARMONIZAÇÃO FACIAL
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para CONSULTORA COMERCIAL | CLÍNICA DE HARMONIZAÇÃO FACIAL em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WANTED: Consultora comercial que sabe que lead quente não espera. E que não vai deixar nenhum escapar.


Cara leitora,

Se você está rolando o LinkedIn há dias vendo as mesmas vagas de sempre...

\"Buscamos profissional proativo com boa comunicação\" \"Requisitos: Excel avançado e experiência na área\" \"Oferecemos: salário compatível com o mercado\"

..e sente que nenhuma dessas vagas te dá vontade de levantar da cadeira e se candidatar...


Para.


Essa aqui é diferente.


Sabe aquela sensação de fazer uma venda e pensar \"eu SABIA que ia fechar\"?


É isso que você vai sentir aqui. Todo dia.


Porque os leads já chegam interessados. Eles viram os resultados no Instagram. Já querem fazer o procedimento. Já estão imaginando como vão ficar. Já pesquisaram sobre harmonização.


O trabalho pesado de gerar desejo? O Instagram já fez.


Só falta uma coisa: alguém que conduza a conversa até o agendamento.


Esse alguém é você.


Você não vai precisar convencer ninguém de que harmonização funciona - os antes e depois fazem isso. Você não vai precisar criar desejo do zero - as fotos e vídeos criam. Você não vai precisar explicar por que vale a pena - as pacientes satisfeitas mostram.


O que você vai precisar fazer é simples e poderoso: responder rápido, entender o momento da cliente, tirar as dúvidas certas, e não deixar ela escapar enquanto \"pensa\".


A clínica entrega o resultado. O Instagram entrega o lead. Você entrega a consulta paga.


É uma máquina. E você é a peça que faz ela funcionar.


Sem você, lead vira só número no direct. Com você, lead vira paciente na agenda, faturamento no caixa, transformação na vida de uma mulher.


SOBRE A CLÍNICA


Somos uma clínica de harmonização facial que transforma a autoestima de mulheres todos os dias.

Nosso Instagram gera interesse. Nossos procedimentos geram resultado. Nossas pacientes geram indicações.

A demanda existe. O desejo existe. A confiança existe.

O que falta é você conectando tudo isso em consultas pagas.


VOCÊ É...


O tipo de pessoa que vê uma notificação no direct e já sente a adrenalina de uma possível conversão.

Que entende que velocidade é conversão - e age de acordo.

Que não manda preço e espera. Manda preço e já prepara o próximo passo.

Que trata \"vou pensar\" como o início da venda, não como o fim.

Que sente satisfação real quando transforma uma conversa difícil em agendamento confirmado.

É quase como se uma closer, uma estrategista e uma organizadora obsessiva tivessem uma filha.

Você tem fome de resultado. E a estrutura pra sustentar isso.


SUA MISSÃO


Transformar seguidores em leads. Transformar leads em consultas pagas. Transformar consultas em pacientes recorrentes.

Seu trabalho é não deixar ninguém escapar do funil.

..mas antes que você fique toda empolgada, vou te interromper aqui...

Porque essa função não é fácil. Ok?


Exige velocidade. Exige organização. Exige resiliência. E exige uma capacidade rara de manter o ritmo intenso dia após dia.

A carga é pesada. O ritmo é acelerado. E a gente só quer quem aguenta o tranco.


NA PRÁTICA, VOCÊ VAI:


● Monitorar o Instagram como um radar: Comentários, DMs, reações, menções. Onde tem interação, tem oportunidade. Você não espera aparecer - você vai buscar.

● Abordar rápido e trazer pro WhatsApp: A rede social é vitrine. O WhatsApp é onde você controla a conversa. Você faz essa ponte em minutos, não em horas.

● Qualificar a necessidade: Entender o que ela quer, qual o momento dela, quais as dúvidas reais. Não é só \"passar informação\" - é descobrir como ajudar ela a decidir.

● Conduzir com estratégia até a consulta PAGA: Você não agenda. Você FECHA. O ciclo só termina quando tem pagamento.

● Confirmar as consultas agendadas: Ligação, mensagem, lembrete. O que for preciso pra garantir que ela apareça. No-show é zero no caixa.

● Follow-up como rotina sagrada:

○ Lead que perguntou e sumiu? Volta nele.

○ Lead que disse \"tá caro\"? Entende a objeção real.

○ Lead que disse \"vou pensar\"? Mantém o relacionamento até ela decidir.

○ Paciente que cancelou? Reagenda.

○ Paciente que fez há 6 meses? Hora da manutenção.

● Trabalhar a base de pacientes existentes: Quem já fez uma vez, volta. Quem gostou, indica. Sua função é ativar isso. Todo dia.

● Manter o CRM organizado em tempo real: Status atualizado, próximo passo definido, histórico completo. Você precisa saber exatamente onde cada lead está no funil.


SEUS INDICADORES DE SUCESSO


O QUE MUDA NO SEU DIA A DIA


Urgência é regra. Seguidor que comentou AGORA precisa ser atendido AGORA. Não daqui a

pouco. Não quando der. AGORA. Lead quente esfria em minutos. A concorrente responde em

segundos. Velocidade é conversão.
