description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Python e LangGraph Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento de agentes conversacionais inteligentes e arquiteturas multiagentes baseadas em IA Generativa, utilizando Python, LangGraph, LangChain e frameworks modernos de orquestração de LLMs. Desenvolver soluções capazes de compreender contexto, raciocinar, tomar decisões e automatizar jornadas completas de vendas e atendimento.


Responsabilidades & Atribuições

Desenvolver agentes inteligentes utilizando Python, LangGraph, LangChain e frameworks de IA Generativa;

Construir arquiteturas multiagentes com capacidade de colaboração, memória, contexto e tomada de decisão;

Desenvolver fluxos conversacionais complexos para canais de voz, chat, WhatsApp, formulários e canais digitais;

Implementar integrações com modelos LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral ou similares);

Desenvolver pipelines RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com busca vetorial e bases corporativas;

Trabalhar na construção de agentes especialistas para retenção, cobrança, suporte técnico, vendas e atendimento;

Desenvolver integrações com APIs corporativas, CRM, sistemas legados, telecom e plataformas omnichannel;

Implementar memória conversacional, reasoning chains e mecanismos de contextualização;

Garantir escalabilidade, observabilidade, monitoramento e governança das soluções de IA;

Participar da definição da arquitetura cognitiva e dos padrões técnicos da plataforma de IA;

Trabalhar com engenharia de prompts, embeddings, vector databases e orchestration engines;

Desenvolver mecanismos de fallback, validação, guardrails e segurança de IA;

Otimizar performance, custo e tempo de resposta das aplicações baseadas em IA;

Colaborar com áreas de negócio, CX, arquitetura, dados e engenharia;

Participar de POCs e evolução contínua das capacidades de IA da plataforma.


Obrigatórias / Essenciais

Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento Python.

Experiência com LangGraph, LangChain ou frameworks similares de IA Generativa.

Conhecimento em arquiteturas multiagentes e agentes autônomos.

Experiência com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI ou similares).

Experiência com RAG, embeddings e vector databases.

Conhecimento em bancos vetoriais como Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, FAISS ou similares.

Experiência com APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída.

Conhecimento em Docker, Kubernetes e cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

Experiência com Git, CI/CD e práticas DevOps.

Conhecimento em engenharia de prompts e context engineering.

Capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos.

Boa comunicação e colaboração multidisciplinar.

Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e integração com soluções globais.

title: Customer Success Specialist (Technical & AI Support)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist (Technical & AI Support) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

TheFutureSociety LLC is a founder-led, profitable startup operating The Tarot Ship (290K+ YouTube subscribers), Great Awakener (a premium all-livestream membership platform), and MAX: Your Virtual Oracle Gateway™ — the world's first AI platform powered by the user's natal chart, launching to scale June 9, 2026. Our founder is a world-renowned thought leader, astrologer, and former EVP of a global tech company. We’re moving fast as we scale.


The Mission

Be the human heart behind our AI. As we scale Meta ads for product launches, such as MAX, you ensure every user feels seen, every technical glitch gets solved fast, and every refund request is handled with care.


What You'll Own

Launch Support.

Manage the Intercom ticket surge during the June 9th MAX launch and ongoing. Target first-response under 2 hours, resolution under 24 hours.


AI & Technical Troubleshooting 

Answer user questions about natal chart integration, ephemeris validation, \"how to talk to MAX\" prompts, and MAX response quality (create automated responses in our chatbot). Escalate technical issues and bring solutions.


Billing Resolution

Partner with our Billing Specialist on high-volume periods — refund requests, failed payment recovery, subscription changes, dispute resolution. Stripe Dashboard fluency required.


Knowledge Base Build

Convert recurring ticket themes into self-serve articles. Reduce ticket volume month-over-month.


Community Engagement

Light daily presence in Great Awakener forum and YouTube comments. Respond to member questions, escalate priority tickets, surface what the community is feeling to the team.


You Are

2-4 years in customer support, success, or community management — ideally for a subscription, SaaS, or membership product. Stripe Dashboard experience essential. Strong written English. Calm under pressure, fast typist, comfortable saying \"I don't know, let me find out\" rather than guessing. Genuine interest in wellness, astrology, or spirituality.


Nice to Have

Experience with Intercom, ClickUp, Kit. Familiarity with AI product support (LLM behavior, prompt issues, edge cases).


Compensation and Details

R$7,500-R$10,000/month depending on experience and location. Full-time, remote.


How to Apply

Send your resume and a brief note (under 200 words) in English to  answering:

  • Walk us through the most frustrated customer you ever turned around. What did you do?
  • Which tools are you familiar with?
  • What made you interested in this role with our company?

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engineering Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Introduction

NextDay AI is a privately held company and world leader specializing in applying artificial intelligence (AI) engineering and creative innovation in B2C entertainment products. Our mission is to leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLM) and generative AI (Gen AI) to create innovative consumer products that push the boundaries of entertainment and companionship. This is a unique opportunity to participate and make a real difference in a company actively working to shape the future of AI applications for consumers.



About the Role

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead one of our cross-functional product engineering teams. This role is ideal for someone with a strong technical foundation who is equally passionate about team leadership. You will manage a group of approximately eight engineers across frontend, backend, mobile, and QA disciplines. Working closely with the Tech Leads, you’ll ensure that the team’s solutions are technically sound and aligned with our broader engineering direction, avoiding isolated decisions that conflict with long-term architectural goals. You’ll also collaborate with QA to maintain the highest standards of quality in everything the team ships.


What the ideal candidate will have

  • Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams in a fast-paced startup or scale-up environment.
  • Strong technical background, with the ability to meaningfully contribute to codebases and guide architectural decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to align team-level execution with broader engineering strategy.
  • Excellent people leadership skills: able to coach, give feedback, manage performance, and build trust.
  • Effective communicator who can bridge the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working with evolving priorities and able to bring clarity and structure to ambiguity.
  • Passionate about building cohesive, motivated teams that deliver consistently.
  • Committed to fostering an inclusive and psychologically safe team environment.
  • Familiarity with our tech stack: React, React Native, Vite, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare, Redux, TypeScript, AWS Lambda functions
  • Experience working in cross-functional product development teams (nice to have).
  • Background in contributing to or managing platform-level or infrastructure initiatives (nice to have).


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support a high-performing, cross-functional engineering team of around eight engineers across frontend, backend, mobile, and QA.
  • Split your time between hands-on contribution (~40%) and people/process management (~60%).
  • Partner with Tech Leads to ensure technical solutions align with our long-term engineering vision, avoiding isolated decisions that conflict with strategic architectural goals.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and QA to ensure priorities are clear and the team consistently delivers high-quality, tested, and maintainable solutions.
  • Foster a strong team culture centered on accountability, autonomy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Coach and mentor engineers to support their professional growth and help resolve performance or interpersonal issues constructively and effectively.
  • Identify process gaps and areas for improvement, then work with the team to design and implement practical, scalable solutions.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our engineering practices as we scale, including hiring, onboarding, and cross-team coordination.


Why Join Us ?

  • Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to \"once per week\")
  • Flex-time / Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results)
  • Unlimited Vacations Policy
  • A dynamic and supportive work environment.
  • Opportunity to work closely with owners and leaders in a fast-growing company at the forefront of the AI revolution.



If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team in the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

title: AEM Content Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AEM Content Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients, a supplyy chain focused company.


Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Content Author Specialist to support the creation, management, and optimization of digital content across our web platforms. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has a strong understanding of content management systems, and is passionate about delivering high-quality user experiences.

Graphic design experience is not required, but candidates with a design background will have an added advantage in enhancing visual content and collaborating effectively with creative teams.


Key Responsibilities

Author, edit, and publish web content using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)

Maintain and update website pages, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with brand standards

Collaborate with UX, marketing, and development teams to implement content strategies

Manage digital assets, including images, videos, and documents within the AEM Digital Asset Manager (DAM)

Ensure content is optimized for performance, accessibility, and SEO best practices

Troubleshoot content issues and provide solutions within AEM

Follow governance standards, workflows, and approval processes for content publishing

Assist with content audits and quality assurance to ensure a seamless user experience


Required Qualifications

Proven experience working with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) as a content author or in a similar role

Strong understanding of content management systems and web publishing workflows

Familiarity with HTML basics and web content structure (no coding required, but helpful)

High attention to detail and strong organizational skills

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.)

Experience with Figma

ADA Compliance experience a plus

Basic knowledge of graphic design principles (layout, typography, visual hierarchy)

Experience working closely with UX/UI design teams

Understanding of responsive design and mobile-first content strategies

Knowledge of analytics tools or A/B testing platforms

What Sets You Apart

A strong eye for visual detail and user experience

Ability to turn design concepts into polished, web-ready content

Proactive problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn new tools

title: Técnico de laboratório - Setor Microbiologia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Técnico de laboratório - Setor Microbiologia em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Técnico de Laboratório – Setor Microbiologia


Horário de trabalho:  07:30 - 17:18

Local : Vargem Pequena/Florianópolis

Critério obrigatório : Disponibilidade de trabalhar aos finais de semana mediante a escala predefinida

Salário : R$ 3.100,65 a R$ 3.418,47+ benefícios


Descrição:

A Levteck Tecnologia Viva busca por um(a) Técnico de Laboratório Industrial Júnior para compor nosso time e contribuir com a organização e fluidez dos nossos processos! 

Se você é uma pessoa que gosta de processos bem descritos, trabalho em equipe, atenta aos detalhes, responsável, com raciocínio lógico e boa comunicação, essa oportunidade é para você!


Principais atividades:

- É de responsabilidade do Técnico de Laboratório Júnior preparar e realizar o inóculo dos reatores, bem como a drenagem e limpeza deles;

- Efetuar a produção dos meios de cultura, esterilização e controles de qualidade dos meios;

- Preparar e executar análises físico-químicas e microbiológicas;

- Efetuar a contagem de células, envasar os produtos, realizar testes e controles de contaminação;

- Embalar e expedir os produtos conforme o padrão pré-estabelecido;

- Efetuar a calibração do phmetro semanalmente;

- Efetuar o controle de estoque de consumíveis, reagentes e produto finalizado;

- Efetuar os registros pertinentes a cada atividade de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos e de acordo com as Boas Práticas de Fabricação;

- Auxiliar na retirada dos lixos do laboratório e da copa diariamente e auxiliar na segregação correta do lixo reciclado;

- Realizar todas as atividades com a máxima qualidade, mantendo a organização. 


Perfil comportamental necessário:

Acuidade; Organização;​ Responsabilidade;​ Pró-atividade; Gostar de trabalhar em equipe;​ Persistência; Agilidade; ​Bom relacionamento interpessoal; Habilidade para lidar com tarefas de média complexidade; Cultura da Qualidade.​


Perfil técnico necessário:

Ter formação em engenharia de alimentos, ciência de alimentos, biologia, farmácia ou áreas correlatas. Ter conhecimento básico sobre microrganismos e formas de desinfecção, boas práticas laboratoriais.


Conhecimento diferencial:

Técnicas de microbiologia, plaqueamento, conhecimento de meios de cultura, contagem de leveduras, trabalhar em fluxo laminar, identificar contaminações.


Formação:

Nível superior em eng de alimentos, biologia, biotecnologia, bioprocessos, farmácia ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais da Levteck

- Vale alimentação em cartão bonificação no valor de R$ 900,00;

- Vale combustível no valor de R$ 175,00 ou vale transporte;

- DayOff para você aproveitar seu dia com quem mais ama;

- Confraternização dos aniversariantes do mês;

- Bonificação extra em programa de metas;

- Plano de carreira;

- Treinamentos trimestrais em temas como saúde, bem-estar, comunicação assertiva, educação financeira, primeiros socorros, entre outros, conforme demanda da equipe;

title: Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Beige is looking for an exceptional, high-energy Video Editor to join our production powerhouse, transform raw footage into visual masterpieces, and elevate our digital storytelling capabilities.

This is not a traditional, slow-paced editing role. You will operate as a critical driver of our creative output, taking extreme ownership of asset management, motion graphics, and premium post-production workflows for a rapidly growing media technology startup.

If you're someone who thrives in high-performance environments, possesses cutting-edge technical skills, and is obsessed with visual precision and pacing, we want to hear from you.

About Beige

Beige is an AI-powered media technology platform transforming how content is booked, produced, managed, and delivered at scale.

Through Beige.app, businesses, brands, creators, events, families, and enterprises can seamlessly access content production, media services, creative talent, and technology-driven workflows through a modern, intelligent platform.

We have facilitated thousands of productions and work with startups, major brands, Fortune 500 companies, athletes, creators, celebrities, and high-profile individuals across the United States and internationally. We're building much more than a service company — we're building infrastructure for the future of content.

As Beige scales aggressively, we're building a team obsessed with speed, ownership, execution, innovation, and growth.

Location & Schedule

  • Location: Remote (International / Global Talent)
  • Schedule: Must be fully available to operate and collaborate during the following US Central Standard Time (CST) hours:
  • Monday - Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CST

Compensation

  • Contract Rate: Starting at $400/month

What You'll Be Doing

  • Asset & Footage Management: Efficiently download, structure, and organize massive batches of raw multimedia assets for seamless editing workflows.
  • Premium Video Editing: Edit high-quality video content that directly meets and exceeds strict project brief requirements and client expectations.
  • Advanced Post-Production: Apply advanced editing techniques, including smooth transitions, continuous pacing, text overlays, and audio syncing.
  • Motion Graphics & Animation: Integrate clean motion graphics and 2D animation to drive engagement and elevate production value.
  • Color & Audio Enhancement: Execute professional color correction, grading, and sound mixing to ensure visually stunning and acoustically crisp final deliverables.
  • Pipeline Speed: Ruthlessly hit tight production deadlines while keeping asset quality, creativity, and rendering optimization locked in.

Who We're Looking ForRequired Qualifications:

  • Strong English Proficiency: High fluency in written and spoken English with exceptional team communication skills.
  • Proven Experience: Minimum of 2+ years of professional video editing and motion graphics experience within an agency, production house, or startup environment.
  • Software Mastery: Expert-level mastery of Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects (or equivalent industry-standard professional editing tools).
  • Technical Hardware Setup: A powerful, dedicated editing machine alongside highly reliable high-speed internet and stable power backup/electricity.
  • Creative Portfolio: A comprehensive, high-quality showreel or portfolio demonstrating your editing pace, design style, and technical versatility.

Preferred / Major Plus:

  • Deep experience editing content specifically tailored for the creator economy, social media platforms (TikTok, Reels, YouTube), or premium corporate brand campaigns.
  • Advanced proficiency using AI generation and automation tools to accelerate asset workflows.
  • Familiarity with modern remote productivity and tracking tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, Notion).

Core Behavioral Expectations:

To succeed in this role, you must be obsessed with visual detail and speed. You need to welcome rapidly shifting creative priorities, accept constructive feedback with professionalism, and actively prefer executing high-impact digital storytelling over low-stakes, formulaic editing routines.

title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS [DESENVOLVEDOR SAP ABAP]
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS [DESENVOLVEDOR SAP ABAP] em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.


ESPECIALISTA NÍVEL SENIOR – DESENVOLVEDOR SAP ABAP

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Diferencial: Experiência com desenvolvimento Abap para SAP HCM.
  • Conhecimento avançado em:
